implemented_contracts: relia init now syncs the generated .relia/.gitignore experience-shard rule with memory.commit_experiences and removes the managed /experiences/ rule when users opt in to committing shards
relia check now validates relia.yaml against schemas/relia-config.schema.json for the schema subset used by the checked-in config contract
memory.org_eligible: true now fails closed through redaction_safety_failed with exit 6 and redaction_status failed_closed
focused regression tests cover schema-required top-level config sections, org-sharing fail-closed behavior, and init reruns after commit_experiences is enabled

resolved_review_findings.summary: Existing relia.yaml configs now remove the generated .relia/.gitignore /experiences/ rule when memory.commit_experiences is true.
loadAndValidateConfig now applies schemas/relia-config.schema.json to relia.yaml and rejects missing schema-required sections such as metadata, attribution, and outcomes.
memory.org_eligible now uses the same fail-closed redaction/share-safety error path as non-private share_scope.

summary.lifecycle_boundary: task-executor repair only; commit, PR update, scope closure, validation-gate, and post-merge evidence are left to their required workers
